n: A research tool updated this week now turns a long report into a deck, looks at the finished pages, and fixes what it sees. Its rule for every page is one headline sentence that states the point. You can borrow both habits today. Before you share a deck, write the one sentence each page is there to say. Then look at the finished pages yourself, the way your reader will, before you send them.
